headline: Bad News for Energy Consumers. Tariffs Could Rise by Up to 10% - Forbes.ro
summary: Romanian energy consumers face possible tariff increases of up to 10%, according to Forbes Romania. The report does not give further detail in the candidate text.
why: Electricity and gas tariffs affect household incomes, inflation and the regulated pricing environment for utilities in Romania.
